text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday chaired a cabinet meeting on the financing of political parties.
- President Ben Ali leaves for two-day visit to Italy on May 28.
- Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam on Monday held talks in Tunis with President Ben Ali on the Middle East peace process.
- President Ben Ali on Monday asked Prime minister Hamed Karoui to open the 19th congress of the Arab Lawyers Union to be held in the eastern holiday resort of Sousse on May 27.
- Cabinet meeting on Monday recommends the consecration of political parties role.
- Meeting of Arab Cities Organization to be held in Tunis on May 26-28.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui on Monday received the Secretary General of the Organisation of Islamic Conference (OIC) over ways to reinforce solidarity between Islamic countries.
